note: Deutsche Bank's AktivKonto: a basic price of 6.90 euros a month, with no condition that waives it. Read again 2026-10-30 with the AktivKonto's Entgeltinformation (15 October 2026): online SEPA transfers are in the monthly price without limit (domestic 0); withdrawals at Deutsche Bank and Cash Group machines are included (own 0); at another bank's machine in euros or abroad 1%, at least 5.99 EUR (abroad written as that charge; at home the form holds one figure, so another bank's machine at home isn't written); paying by debit card in another currency 1% (at least 1.50 EUR, a floor the form doesn't hold); a justified refusal of a direct debit or transfer for want of funds 0.68 EUR; the tolerated overdraft (geduldete Überziehung, what a holder without an arranged line meets) 13.30% a year, the arranged one (eingeräumte) 11.85%, its limit set per customer. Not stated: interest on the account, a transfer outside SEPA (in the Preis- und Leistungsverzeichnis, not read), what opening asks, a savings account.
